name: unraid-control
description: Full control of an Unraid server (Unraid OS 7.x, live-verified on 7.3.2 / unraid-api 4.35.1) from Claude Code. Bundles an MCP server that authenticates to Unraid's official GraphQL API (api-key auth) and exposes both a generic GraphQL passthrough reaching the entire schema (Query/Mutation/Subscription, bundled offline since live introspection is disabled by default) and curated tools for system health, the array & disks, Docker containers, VMs, shares, notifications, UPS, network, users/API keys, plugins and logs — plus a control skill and slash-command workflows.
